acceptance_criteria.condition: All 44 v5 condition artifact directories are retained, and the report's raw-tree digest, interruption count, candidate-write state, and 503/429 classification match those artifacts.
The interrupted collection cannot be analyzed or described as evidence of repair-success or causal-capability improvement.
The public documentation distinguishes the valid v4 negative result from the ineligible v5 interrupted collection and names the required fresh-corpus retest rule.

invariants: A nonzero or interrupted Agent exit is not a successful trial even when it has written a candidate patch that passes visible or hidden checks.
No incomplete v5 condition is dropped, relabeled as an ordinary repair failure, or used in a paired effect statistic.
No Skill-effect or model-wide causal-capability claim follows from this interrupted collection.
Any later formal experiment uses a new preregistration and a fresh held-out corpus after Skill tuning.

safeguards.name: raw-evidence preservation
safeguards.rationale: Every per-condition transcript, candidate diff, public result, and hidden-score result is committed without whitespace normalization.

safeguards.name: incomplete-trial exclusion
safeguards.rationale: The existing frozen analyzer rejects trial_complete=false instead of treating an interrupted agent as a baseline or Skill failure.

safeguards.name: independent artifact consistency check
safeguards.rationale: A regression test recomputes the raw-tree digest and verifies every reported interruption against the raw condition artifacts.

design_boundary.rationale: The runner owns per-condition artifact capture; the report only classifies captured conditions; the frozen analyzer owns eligibility and refuses incomplete trials.

dependency_audit.rationale: The archival report and regression test use only existing Python standard-library and project tooling.

extension_decision.rationale: No public code extension or runtime adapter is introduced.

data_ownership.rationale: The v5 raw directory is the authoritative record for this interrupted collection; the report derives only reproducible metadata from it.

error_model.rationale: Service 503 and 429 exhaustion are explicit interrupted states, including the two candidates written before final Agent failure.

contract_evolution.rationale: The frozen v5 protocol and scorer are unchanged after collection.

operational_budget.rationale: The existing runner's agent timeout remains in force; service retry exhaustion is recorded rather than rerun or hidden.

threat_boundary.rationale: Raw logs are retained as protocol evidence; no secret values are added and no hidden case is supplied to an Agent.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: This self-contained archival correction is one verified Git change and will be pushed only after its checks pass.

release_recovery.rationale: This offline Skill package has no production rollout.

data_migration.rationale: No production schema or persistent user data changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No configuration or credential values are changed or committed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README, interruption record, and evidence ledger document exactly why the run cannot support an effect claim and how a future formal run must differ.

reproducibility.rationale: The frozen preregistration, raw-tree digest, condition artifacts, model/Harness IDs, seed, and regression check are committed together.

verification.result: The report matched all 44 raw condition artifact directories, 12 incomplete agent conditions, the two service error classes, and the complete raw-tree SHA-256.
The frozen analyzer's incomplete-trial rejection remains covered and the v5 interruption record remains internally consistent.
No whitespace errors in the evidence archive, documentation, or regression test.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the raw v5 archive, interruption record, evidence artifact, README note, test, and v5 raw-transcript gitattributes rule together; leave the frozen preregistration untouched.

independent_review.reviewer: artifact-consistency regression test and frozen analyzer contract tests
independent_review.notes: The checks approve the integrity and ineligibility classification of the archive, not a Skill-effect claim.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Frozen v5 paired effect protocol recorded before collection.
Ineligible v5 collection report with full raw-tree digest and all interrupted conditions.
Regression test tying the report's count, error classification, candidate-write state, and raw-tree digest to the retained artifacts.
Frozen paired analyzer that rejects incomplete trials before effect calculation.

remaining_risks: v5 is ineligible for a repair-success or causal-capability inference because 12 of 44 agent calls ended with upstream service errors.
The archive establishes a protocol fact about this collection, not an aggregate fact about the model or Skill.
Any future run must not tune against the retained v5 hidden contracts and must use a new held-out corpus.
